title: Images
subtitle: Every container image on a node: how big it is, which apps and deploys it came from, and what is safe to remove.

cleanup.title: Remove unused images
cleanup.description: These images are not live, not a rollback target, not one of the newest {{keep}} deploys of any app, and no container uses them.
cleanup.consequences: Live images, rollback targets and recent deploys are never removed. Removed images are pulled or rebuilt again if an app needs them.

retention.title: Image retention
retention.description: How many recent deploy images this app keeps for rollback. The cleanup removes older ones on its next run.
retention.hint: 0 follows the global setting, otherwise {{min}} or more.
retention.protected: This app is in the protected environment {{env}}, so it keeps at least {{global}} images.
retention.wouldRemove_one: The next cleanup would remove {{count}} image, freeing {{size}}.
retention.wouldRemove_other: The next cleanup would remove {{count}} images, freeing {{size}}.
retention.alwaysKept: The running image, rollback pins, the previous successful release, images shared with other apps and images a queued or held deploy needs are always kept.

source.app: Keeps the newest {{count}} deploy images (set on this app).
source.app_default: Keeps the newest {{count}} deploy images (the default for apps).
source.global: Keeps the newest {{count}} deploy images (the global setting, {{global}}).
